summary: Add signed native fleet roll authority and own-daemon adoption collection for fleet/roll-completion: every immutable target host verifies within 24h, with a roll-level 10% allowance over 30 days.

replay.detail: Signed existing resource.observed graph claims are authority. Startup revalidates committed signed claim references; a commit observer admits replicated declarations, resolutions and host observations, retaining missing dependencies until subsequent commits. Unsigned legacy roll-receipts.sqlite3 is diagnostic only, never replayed as authority.

schema.detail: No new registered claim or resource kinds. Existing resource.observed claims use the open custom resource instance custom.fractal.fleet-roll-receipt and carry version-1 declaration, host-target-resolved or host-observed facts with existing whole-record claim signatures. POST /v1/slo and fractal slo ingest-roll accept a graph claim ID only. POST /v1/slo/observe accepts a signed resolution claim ID only. The separate roll-signed-receipts.sqlite3 ledger retains admitted claim references, immutable keys and admission times.

rules.detail: Only an actual bound agent with the declared roll-authority resource binding may publish declarations and resolutions. Resolutions bind the admitted declaration claim and same signer. Generic public host-observed publication is forbidden, including bound agents: only the own-daemon collector measures actual profiles, compiled revision and readiness, then signs as host/HOST. Cohort, resolution and clock are immutable. An omitted factory_revision target requires no factory proof; an explicit target still requires exact independent proof, otherwise unknown. Holds never pause the clock. Missing evidence never becomes good or bad.

compatibility.detail: SLO reads gain one generic native row. Population remains accepted-declarations-only; external population coverage is unknown. Older unsigned receipt JSON import is removed rather than retained as an insecure alternate authority. Existing graph signatures and resource bindings are reused without new keys or hardcoded private principals.

downtime.detail: No interruption beyond installing/restarting the daemon. Signed ledger replay completes before serving; replicated missing dependencies remain unknown while admission catches up.

manual.detail: Declare the roll-authority resource on the actual deployment agent and execute declaration/resolution publication as that assigned bound agent, not an agentless run impersonating it. Publish generic claims through fractal claim, then admit their IDs. Request own-host observation through its Unix daemon socket. Republish legitimate old unsigned receipts through the authorized signed producer; unsigned state is not promoted automatically.

recovery.detail: Preserve graph claims and signatures plus signed receipt reference ledger/WAL in backups. Exact signed retries are idempotent and conflicts are refused. Graph replay re-establishes source authority; unauthenticated JSON cannot predeclare a legitimate roll ID. Missing graph provenance or unavailable probes remain unknown.
